nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What is the range of native species considered to be winners according to McKinney and Lockwood (1999)?
nodes.answer: The range of native species considered to be winners is between 5 to 29%, with either stable or expanding ranges.

nodes.label: Conservation
nodes.question: What ecological aspect was assessed regarding G. barbata populations?
nodes.answer: The relevance of ecological restoration of G. barbata populations was assessed.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Reforestation initiatives|Reintroduction of native species_qna_002
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: How has human-related impact affected native birds in Hawaii?
nodes.answer: Over half of the native birds in Hawaii have become extinct due to human-related impacts.
